conclusion: Two independent checks of the original paper, both supplements, and cited Smart-seq3 V.3 protocol resolve the primer, crRNA, reporter and inherited RT/WTA oligos. Exact per-well Nextera index assignment remains unresolved; no absence claim is accepted.
